method: Commercial location map supplies identity and adjacency only. No colored rectangle is converted into metric footprint.
Retained close-up and wide photographs determine frontage direction, glass vs counter, shallow kiosk vs rear-facade cafe, independent roof and pier inclusion.
Current R19 support rows, exterior footprint and current walls are coordinate anchors. Specific tenant endpoints/depths remain MODEL; packet does not claim photographic world calibration.
North shops use common actual physical facade context; western shops vary orientation, depth, recess and boundary. No blanket same-depth grid subdivision.
Current columns are existing coordinate references with their literal unconfirmed authority retained; no column is moved/confirmed by this packet.
Review polygons can intersect a structural column when the column is inside shop territory; this does not authorize deleting or duplicating that column.
important_limits: North support-bay identity still requires user review; source row ordinal and adjacent-photo matching do not prove an individual current column ID.
Western longitudinal positions, especially Sowoldang/Godeungeo and pharmacy inner chain, are lower-confidence MODEL. They are concrete review regions, not observed lease boundaries.
Main floor coverage is a warning measure, not floor change authority. Current native matching-level floor coverage must be included before treating a proposal as outside.
Do not restore old C21/C22 booths or material recipes.
Do not use 1F Artbox may2026 image for2F; source filename can mislead.
R18 common-band packets use [qx,qy] whereas this packet uses [qx,-qy]; old upper-band owner/geometry alone does not establish store location.
